title: Drop Airflow 2 Support in Chart
body:
Remove Airflow 2.x support from our Helm Chart.

Note: As agreed the current minimum version with this PR is set to 3.1.0 but actually looking at the chart there is no benefit from lower binding to 3.0.0. With this PR and dropping Airflow 2 support there is currently NO version specific logic contained anymore. Seems we had no structural change since 3.0.0 that needs complexity in the chart.

Interestingly I found also three bugs while carving-out the Airflow 2 logic that were hidden and are fixed implicitly:

- Dag Processor, triggerer and scheduler always received webserver_config.py being mounted even though it never should have. And unconditionally with the webserver settings from Airflow 2 also when deployed in Airflow 3
- chart/templates/scheduler/scheduler-networkpolicy.yaml and chart/templates/triggerer/triggerer-networkpolicy.yaml had a copy&paste error and wrong component name
- In one pytest the expected outcome was passed as input to chart generation and tested always wrong logic.

@Miretpl your review would be welcome as well!

In terms of cleaning not as close as wiping all AI generated code on the other side in https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65865 :-D
